unit: source rig authored in metres; output worldSize in current renderer game pixels
pixelSampling: nearest, binary alpha, transparent background, no baked shadows, no full-bright emissive stroke

sourceCamera.projection: fixed orthographic 2.5D; one camera for every clip and school

fire.staff: charred wood, iron ember fork; albedo ember unlit unless explicit emission

frost.staff: blue-grey frost-carved haft and angular crystalline crown

storm.staff: blackened bronze conductive prongs, fine restrained brass bands

arcane.staff: weathered silver astral cage and inset violet stone

necromancer.staff: dark bone-carved collar, runic iron and tarnished green stone

summoner.staff: gnarled wood, animal-carved totem and bound natural cord

materialPassPolicy: Author normal/height/caster from exact same pose and source geometry, never RGB/brightness guessed normals. Albedo alpha defines silhouette; caster silhouette is synchronized and separate from gameplay collision.
integration: Once approved, copy atlas bundles under wwwroot/art/characters/wizard/<school>/ and use existing shared spriteFrame binding from PR #332; do not add a mage-specific shader

required: walk foot plants and looping gait
six staffs distinct at gameplay scale
